core_obligations: Part (1): for a flat morphism g : Y -> X and y over V flat over Y, the composite g(y) : V -> X is flat (Morphisms of Stacks, Lemma stacks-morphisms-lemma-composition-flat), so F(g(y)) = 0 and g^*F = g^{-1}F(y) = F(g(y)) is parasitic (proof lines 1424-1433).
Part (2)(a): tau-covering members lie over flat morphisms of schemes, so parasiticity passes to the sheafification (F^+)^+ (proof lines 1435-1444).

Part (2)(b): submodules and quotients of parasitic tau-modules are parasitic, and the short exact sequence case is evaluated on objects over flat morphisms; cite Homology, Lemma homology-lemma-characterize-serre-subcategory (proof lines 1435-1444).
Part (3): smooth covering descent for an etale sheaf; jointly surjective smooth family with each pullback parasitic gives F parasitic (proof lines 1446-1458).
Part (4): flat lfp covering descent for an fppf sheaf, analogous argument (proof lines 1460-1488).
proof_roadmap: Flat pullback; sheafification and Serre; smooth descent; flat lfp descent.
difficulty_reason: Four-part closure: flat pullback, sheafification and Serre property in five topologies, smooth covering descent, flat lfp covering descent; each part written out. H3: lengthy.
